changed: With Free-text entry on, typing a line into a figure that is already in the dance and pressing Enter now replaces that figure with what the line reads as, in its place, and a line that reads as several figures replaces it with all of them. Anything unrecognized becomes a custom figure marked unparsed, which Re-check custom figures can pick up later. Typing a move's name and choosing it works as before, and with Free-text entry off a typed line is still kept as a custom figure.
With Free-text entry on, a new dance starts with no figures instead of eight stand stills, unless you have saved your own starting figures. Dances you already saved are not changed.
